table.name: documents
table.summary: A master table storing metadata and status information for various documents, including their type, shipping agent, receipt details, and current processing state.

document_id.name: document_id
document_id.meaning: Unique identifier for each document record in the system.

document_status_code.name: document_status_code
document_status_code.meaning: Current processing or lifecycle status of the document.

other_details.name: other_details
other_details.meaning: Additional short code or flag providing supplementary information about the document.
